author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Ryan Waldschmidt (thumb) has X-rays return negative
desc: Ryan Waldschmidt exited Friday's game against the Los Angeles Dodgers in the sixth inning after being hit by a pitch on his right thumb. He underwent X-rays after the game, which came back negative.
impact: Waldschmidt, the Diamondbacks' top prospect, returned to the majors Friday after being recalled from the minors but was forced to exit early. He has been diagnosed with a right thumb contusion and is considered day-to-day. It's unclear if he'll be available for Saturday's game, as the team plans to monitor the swelling and mobility in his thumb closer to first pitch.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Corbin Burnes (elbow/shoulder) begins throwing program
desc: Corbin Burnes has begun a throwing program after Friday's follow-up MRI came back clean.
impact: Burnes underwent Tommy John surgery in June 2025 and suffered a teres major strain in May 2026 while facing live hitters during his throwing program. He has resumed throwing, currently playing catch on flat ground every other day, and will eventually progress to mound work. He could make his 2026 debut in September.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Jordan Lawlar (hamstring) begins hitting in cage
desc: Jordan Lawlar has begun hitting in the cage and doing running mechanics.
impact: Lawlar was placed on the 10-day injured list June 20 with a right hamstring strain. He has resumed baseball activities and is scheduled to undergo a follow-up MRI on July 17 to monitor his progress. A clearer timeline for his return should emerge once the MRI results are available.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Dane Myers (shoulder) hopeful to be activated July 17
desc: Dane Myers is hopeful to be activated from the injured list for the Cincinnati Reds' first game after the All-Star break on July 17 against the Rockies.
impact: Myers suffered a left shoulder contusion on June 29 against the Milwaukee Brewers after crashing into the outfield wall while making a running catch. He received an injection in his AC joint on July 4 and will spend the All-Star break working out at the Reds' complex to prepare for his return.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Robert Gasser recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Milwaukee Brewers recalled Robert Gasser from Triple-A Nashville on Saturday.
impact: With Kyle Harrison (forearm) landing on the 15-day injured list, Gasser is expected to take his spot in the rotation. Across eight starts this season, he has posted a 4.15 ERA and 1.18 WHIP with 40 strikeouts over 43.1 innings. He could draw a start during the Brewers' series against the Miami Marlins next weekend.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Kyle Harrison (forearm) placed on IL
desc: The Milwaukee Brewers placed Kyle Harrison on the 15-day injured list Saturday due to left forearm tightness, retroactive to July 9.
impact: Harrison last pitched July 8 against the Cardinals, allowing three earned runs across four innings in the outing in which he sustained the injury. He does not have a clear timeline for a return. In a corresponding move, the Brewers recalled Robert Gasser from Triple-A Nashville, and he is expected to take Harrison's spot in the rotation.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kyle Karros racks up three hits in win over Giants
desc: Kyle Karros went 3-for-5 in a win over the Giants with two RBI.
impact: Karros continues a productive stretch at the plate, recording hits in 14 of his last 17 contests. The 23-year-old offers manager Warren Schaeffer one of the more consistent bats in a streaky Rockies lineup to this point, carrying an .802 OPS with eight home runs, 33 RBI, 46 runs scored, and three stolen bases through 91 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Tanner Gordon limits damage in no-decision
desc: Tanner Gordon allowed one earned run on eight hits while striking out one over five innings in Friday's 4-3 win over the Giants.
impact: Gordon has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing four earned runs or more in four of his last six trips to the mound. The right-hander remains one of many dismal options as part of an underwhelming Rockies rotation, posting a 6.44 ERA and 1.61 WHIP with an 0-2 record and 8.4 K/9 ratio through 12 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Rafael Devers homers in loss to Rockies
desc: Rafael Devers went 3-for-3 in a loss to the Rockies with a home run, one run scored, and three RBI.
impact: Devers continues a torrid stretch at the plate, picking up hits in 14 of his last 17 contests. The first baseman has frustrated fantasy managers as one of many inconsistent options in the Giants lineup to this point, carrying an .808 OPS with 19 home runs, 52 RBI, and 48 runs scored across 94 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Luis Arraez racks up three hits, swipes base in loss to Rockies
desc: Luis Arraez went 3-for-4 in a 4-3 loss to the Rockies with a walk, one run scored, and one stolen base.
impact: Arraez continues a productive stretch at the plate, registering hits in 14 of his last 17 contests. The infielder offers manager Tony Vitello one of the more consistent options in an inconsistent Giants lineup, slashing .331 with four home runs, 35 RBI, 47 runs scored, and eight stolen bases across 89 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Robbie Ray fights command issues in no-decision
desc: Robbie Ray allowed one earned run on four hits and six walks while striking out four over five innings in Friday's loss to the Rockies.
impact: Ray continues a solid stretch on the mound of late, allowing one earned run or less in five of his last seven trips to the mound. The left-hander provides manager Tony Vitello with one of the more stable options as part of an underperforming Giants rotation, posting a 3.38 ERA and 1.27 WHIP with an 8-6 record and 1.7 K/BB ratio across 19 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kirby Yates nails down save as Angels edge Twins
desc: Kirby Yates allowed one hit in a scoreless frame to earn the save in a 4-3 win over the Twins.
impact: Yates continues a steady stretch out of the bullpen of late, holding opponents scoreless in seven of his last eight contests. The right-hander offers manager Kurt Suzuki one of the more reliable options as part of an underwhelming Angels staff, posting a 3.00 ERA and 1.00 WHIP with three saves and a 12.00 K/9 ratio across 24 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Grayson Rodriguez grinds through traffic in win over Twins
desc: Grayson Rodriguez allowed three earned runs on six hits and one walk over 5 1/3 innings in Friday's win over the Twins.
impact: Rodriguez has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three or more runs in each of his last four trips to the mound. The right-hander remains one of many dismal starting options in the Angels rotation for manager Kurt Suzuki, posting a 7.55 ERA and 1.74 WHIP with a 3-2 record and 1.5 K/BB ratio through seven starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Vaughn Grissom goes deep in win over Twins
desc: Vaughn Grissom went 2-for-3 in a win over the Twins with a home run, one run scored, and two RBI.
impact: Grissom has heated up at the plate of late, recording hits in four of his last five contests. The infielder remains one of many inconsistent bats in the Angels lineup for manager Kurt Suzuki, batting .256 with five home runs, 36 RBI, and 22 runs scored across 55 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Yordan Alvarez goes yard in loss to Rangers
desc: Yordan Alvarez went 2-for-4 in a loss to the Rangers with a solo home run.
impact: Alvarez has caught fire at the plate once again, collecting hits in six of his last nine contests. The 29-year-old continues to reward fantasy managers with an elite option in all formats, carrying a 1.038 OPS with 30 home runs, 68 RBI, 63 runs scored, and one stolen base across 94 games.
